text:
Aisha (People Ops): Quick update: new Visitor Safety & Access addendum is live in the handbook. Everyone doing in-person work should complete the 5-min module by next Friday. https://redwood.example.com/visitor-addendum :memo:
Tom (Eng): Is this targeted at vendors only or all guests (family, deliveries, interview candidates)?
Aisha (People Ops): All guests. We clarified categories so hosts know which steps apply (vendors vs candidates vs personal visitors). Hosts who expect >3 visitors at once need pre-approval from Office Ops.
Rina (Office): FYI we'll need a heads-up for large groups so we can reserve lobbies and extra escorts. Use the "large-visitor" form: https://redwood.example.com/large-visitor-request
Diego (Recruiting): For interview candidates joining onsite, do panelists need to be pre-cleared by security?
Aisha (People Ops): Panelists must do the module, and interview schedulers should add candidate details in the visitor system. Security will run a quick access check if the candidate meets certain risk flags.
Tom (Eng): Can managers mark their teams as complete? Doing per-person reminders is rough right now.
Aisha (People Ops): Yes, we've added a manager bulk-submit. Managers can upload a CSV with employee_emails and host_ids. We'll validate and mark them complete. Link: https://redwood.example.com/bulk-submit
Compliance Bot: New assignment created (visitor_addendum_v1). Due in 7 days.
Tom (Eng): Will completion appear in people-ops exports? I need to filter by office location and host name.
Aisha (People Ops): Export will include: employee_email, completion_ts, host_name, office_location, visitor_type, exemption_flag. We'll run weekly on Mondays.
Rina (Office): Can we get a column for "badge_needed"? For some cases we pre-print badges.
Aisha (People Ops): Added badge_needed and escort_required to the CSV. Thanks.
Diego (Recruiting): What about interviews scheduled <48h from candidate arrival — is there a grace process?
Aisha (People Ops): Yes, an expedited acknowledgement can be issued by the host if they submit the candidate details and confirm they will escort. Expedited requests auto-expire after 72h. Use this shortcut form: https://redwood.example.com/expedite
Tom (Eng): Any changes to the handbook language around confidential projects? We sometimes have shadow interns who need limited access.
Aisha (People Ops): Handbook now states guests may not access confidential project data unless a signed NDA + explicit project owner approval are recorded in the visitor form. Shadow interns are treated as "temporary staff" and need sponsor approval.
Compliance Bot: Weekly export generated (ts: 1764205920)  rows: 129 required, 102 completed, 7 exemptions, 20 pending. CSV: https://redwood.example.com/exports/1764205920.csv
Diego (Recruiting): I'll ping the interviewers who are still pending.
Rina (Office): I'll coordinate badge pickup times once export hits my inbox.
Aisha (People Ops): Thanks team  I'll send a short reminder tomorrow morning for anyone pending >48h. If you need a one-off exemption, mention me directly here. :raised_hands:
